name: Synth
author: NucleoOS + AMY (Brian Whitman, Dan Ellis)
description: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

descriptions.en: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.
descriptions.it: Sintetizzatore polifonico con il motore AMY: 128 suoni Juno-106 e 128 DX7 piu' un pianoforte. Tastiera multi-touch di due ottave, dieci preset, volume, timbro e riverbero.
